decision_basis.audit: 64 residual programs, 16 TSP100 validation instances, 5 paired ACO seeds, horizons 500/2000/5000
decision_basis.pilot: 3 generations, population 100, 128 TSP100 training instances per generation
decision_basis.policy: Use the combined basin/final objective. Select the smallest residual radius that preserves a useful basin improvement without degrading the final gap. Keep Origin as an ablation because its final-gap benefit was not consistent.
